title: wa.message.received
description: PAYLOAD of the `wa.message.received` envelope. Topic: engagement.wa.message.received. ★ Crown-jewel CTWA signal (§11.2 — makes the WA-first funnel fully optimizable where competitors stop at 'conversation started'). Emitted via the Origin Connector (§3.4) on an inbound WA message from the live /whatsapp/inbound webhook. When the message carries a CTWA referral (ctwa_clid + source ad id) the signals service dispatches business-messaging CAPI keyed on ctwa_clid -> conversions attributed to the exact ad with ZERO pixels (§11.2). Inbound body -> intent hints for lead-scoring (§9.5).

text.description: Inbound text (body -> intent hints §9.5; clustered nightly by insight-miner §9.6).

referral.description: ★ CTWA referral (§11.2). Present when the conversation started from a Click-to-WhatsApp ad. ctwa_clid keys the business-messaging CAPI dispatch.

ctwa_clid.description: The CTWA click id — attributes to the exact ad (§11.2).

source_ad_id.description: The Meta ad that drove this conversation.

headline.description: The ad headline the user tapped (context for the welcome reply).

interactive_reply.description: When the user tapped a button (e.g. an approval-inbox Approve/Reject §17.2, or a journey quick-reply).

is_first_touch.description: True when this inbound is the journey root (mints correlation_id, §6.3) — e.g. a fresh CTWA conversation with no prior lead.captured.
